headline: Ola Electric Battery Cell Manufacturing Unit Misses Internal Production Targets
summary: Ola Electric's efforts to build domestic battery cell manufacturing capabilities hit operational delays, with its gigafactory struggling with production yields and target output volumes.
why: Ola Electric is India's prominent electric two-wheeler producer; vertical integration efforts in battery manufacturing impact unit cost margins.

impacts.name: Ola Electric Mobility Limited
impacts.why: Yield struggles at its battery facility undermine expected cost savings and margin targets.
